# Free CPT Code Finder

Free CPT Code Finder is an educational CPT code lookup, wRVU reference, modifier guide, ICD-10 pairing resource, and surgical billing education site for clinicians, trainees, APPs, coders, and medical learners.

Canonical site: https://freecptcodefinder.com/
Sitemap: https://freecptcodefinder.com/sitemap.xml
RSS feed: https://freecptcodefinder.com/feed.xml
Blog index: https://freecptcodefinder.com/blog/
CPT code index: https://freecptcodefinder.com/codes/
Editorial policy: https://freecptcodefinder.com/editorial-policy.html
Contact/corrections: https://freecptcodefinder.com/contact.html

Important content areas:
- CPT code pages with descriptors, wRVUs, related codes, documentation notes, modifier considerations, and educational billing context.
- Surgical coding guides for common general surgery, trauma, acute care surgery, endoscopy, hernia, wound, breast, colorectal, endocrine, and procedural topics.
- Modifier education including 22, 24, 25, 51, 57, 58, 59, 76, 77, 78, and 79.
- wRVU and reimbursement education for clinician productivity, documentation, and case valuation.
- ICD-10 education for common surgical diagnoses and postoperative complications.

Use constraints:
- Educational reference only.
- Not medical advice, legal advice, coding certification, compliance advice, or reimbursement guarantee.
- Users should verify CPT, CMS, NCCI, payer, and institutional guidance before claim submission.
